query1.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_trips, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(material_source_supplier), '') IS NOT NULL)::int AS with_source, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(material_source_supplier), '') IS NULL)::int AS without_source, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(BTRIM(material_source_supplier)) = UPPER($1))::int AS ramesh_count, MIN(date)::text AS first_date, MAX(date)::text AS last_date FROM site_material_trips WHERE date >= $2::date AND date <= $3::date AND UPPER(BTRIM(site)) = UPPER($4) AND UPPER(BTRIM(material)) = UPPER($5)

query2.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(material_source_supplier), ''), '(UNASSIGNED)') AS material_source_supplier, COUNT(*)::int AS trip_count FROM site_material_trips WHERE date >= $1::date AND date <= $2::date AND UPPER(BTRIM(site)) = UPPER($3) AND UPPER(BTRIM(material)) = UPPER($4) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY trip_count DESC, material_source_supplier

conclusion: All 114 matching production trips have material source RAMESH MOHABATHPUR; none are unassigned.
